key_points: Most items are option-chain listings and generic chip-sector commentary, not TXN-specific fundamental news.
Valuation-focused articles say TXN may be overvalued relative to cash flow/GF value, but they are model-based, not event-driven.
A dividend rise and sharper recovery are mildly positive but not enough to change a long-term thesis.
No earnings surprise, guidance change, regulatory/legal, M&A, major product or management event appears in the headlines.
Expect minimal short-term price impact from these headlines.
